thread.title: Dow takes a turn into positive territory in late-session trade, buoyed by Apple's stock - MarketWatch

author: Mark DeCambre
title: Dow takes a turn into positive territory in late-session trade, buoyed by Apple's stock - MarketWatch
text: The Dow Jones Industrial Average late-Tuesday afternoon attempted to score a positive close--its third in a row--propelled partly by gains in shares of Apple Inc. and the broader technology-and-internet sector. The Dow DJIA, -0.06% was most recently poking up by 15 points, or less than 0.1%, at 24,825. Shares of Dow component Apple AAPL, +0.77% were up $1.43, or 0.8%, contributing about 10 points to the price-weighted gauge. A $1 move in any one of the Dow's 30 components translates to a swing of 6.89 points. Technology sectors have led the recent resurgence for markets, with some bullish investors seeing the sector as offering the best near-term growth prospects. Still, the Dow has struggled with financials lagging behind the broader market. Meanwhile, the S&P 500 index SPX, +0.07% was up 0.1% at 2,750, while the technology-and-internet laden Nasdaq Composite Index COMP, +0.41% advancing more than 0.4% at 7,635, set to notch a second straight record close, after notching the first for the index since March 12 on Monday.
